accept.description: what finishing this means — written when the work is asked for, not after

blocked.description: something outside the graph is in the way. Not a status: a blocked task is still open work.

on.description: what it is waiting on, in words

cancelled.description: the mark on a task that was called off

by.description: who called it off — kept as history when that entity is deleted

via.description: what the write came in through — the session or client that made it

completed.description: the mark on a finished task

by.description: who finished it — kept as history when that entity is deleted

via.description: what the write came in through — the session or client that made it

contains.description: that task is part of this one

requires.description: this task waits for that one

status.description: where the task stands — computed from the completed and cancelled marks, never written

statuses.description: every value a task's computed status can take, including marks other plugins add: a task under a live claim reads `wip`, contributed by the plugin that owns the claim component (see MARKS).

task_new.title: File a task
task_new.description: Write down something to do: an entity with task{} and doc{title, body}. It is open because it has neither the completed nor the cancelled mark. Name a project, priority, assignee or domain and it gets a filed{} component too.

title.description: what to do, in a line

body.description: what is being asked for, plus pointers to the details, as Markdown

project.description: the project it is filed under

priority.description: queue order — lower is more urgent

assignee.description: whose queue it is filed in

task_list.title: List tasks
task_list.description: The tasks a query selects, as whole bundles. `.task` is always part of the query and yours is joined onto it; passing no query lists `.task.status=open`. The grammar is the query grammar: `.status=done`, `.filed.project=P-19`, `.priority<3`, a bare word to match text.

task_update.title: Update a task
task_update.description: Change a task's status, title, body or filing. `status` is not a column: done adds the completed mark and removes the cancelled one, cancelled does the reverse, and open removes both. Anything you leave out is left alone.

project.description: the project it is filed under

priority.description: queue order — lower is more urgent

assignee.description: whose queue it is filed in
